'''Popa''' is a [[Rock]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Popapouch]] at 6 bronze stars/19 copies.

==Overview==
Current Description: "The outside world was almost within reach, but no matter what Popa tried, the window wouldn't budge. Nothing to do but stand tall, watch the sky grow dark, and just let things be."

Popa is a purple rarity Tatari.

== Evolution Trial ==
Popa's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Popapouch]] you need to complete the following task:

* Obtain 1 more Popa Tatari via any means.

== Trivia ==
* Popa and its evolutions were added to the game on 10/72026 alongside [[Cactobodhi]] and [[Armavolve]].
